title: Nuxt
notes: Nuxt with server rendering, built with nuxt build into Nitro's node-server output. /about is prerendered at build time through a route rule.
details: Built with nuxt build, whose default Nitro preset is node-server; the .output/server/index.mjs entry, which `node .output/server/index.mjs` runs, is imported into the measured process, on Bun and Deno as on Node. The entry listens as soon as it is imported and does not export its server, and Nitro 2 reads port 0 as unset, so the adapter asks the system for a free port, passes it as NITRO_PORT with NITRO_HOST=127.0.0.1, and waits for the line the entry prints when it listens. Not a default: /about is prerendered through the route rule `prerender: true`, as Nuxt's documentation describes for a page that is the same for every visitor. The item page is a Vue page server-rendered per request, the API route a server/api handler returning an object; the data function lives in shared/utils, which both sides auto-import. Telemetry is off. The related-item links are plain <a href> elements, not NuxtLink: NuxtLink writes an empty class attribute that the shared page check does not accept, so these links navigate with a full page load instead of the client router.
